info.title: Nihon API
info.description:
REST contract of the local Nihon server. Generated from the server's operation declarations; do not edit.

Generated clients send `Nihon-API-Version: 1`. The server refuses a different major version with `400 unsupported_api_version`; `GET /api/health` stays available to every client and reports `apiVersion`. Every response carries `Nihon-Request-Id`, also present in error bodies. Conventions: docs/architecture/api-contract.md.

sessionCookie.name: nihon_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by the server for a `web` client at sign-in.

sessionToken.description: Opaque session token returned to a `native` client at sign-in, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

topic.description: Family of resources that changed; reread its canonical resources. Topics are plain strings: ignore unknown ones. `sessions`: the sessions of your profile changed, reread `getCurrentSession`.

ChangeNotification.description: Data of a `change` event: a committed change visible to the subscriber. It never carries the changed data.

reason.description: Why: `new_subscription` (no position sent), `server_restarted`, `too_far_behind` (more changes were missed than the server keeps), or `unknown_position`. Clients act the same way for every reason, including new ones.

ResyncNotification.description: Data of a `resync` event: the missed changes cannot be listed; reread every resource the client shows.

apiVersion.description: Contract version the server implements; clients compare its major part.

code.description: Stable, snake_case error code. Clients branch on it, never on the message.

message.description: English explanation for developers; not meant for display.

requestId.description: Correlates the response with the server log.

path.description: Location of the invalid input, such as `query.limit`.

issues.description: Present on `validation_failed`: one entry per invalid input.

id.description: Opaque identifier of 1 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`.

username.description: Display form of the username, NFKC-normalized, case preserved.

role.description: Permission role. Every new account is `user`; the role cannot be chosen at registration.

registeredWith.description: How the profile was created: `local` for a username and password, otherwise the provider identifier.

Profile.description: A local Nihon profile. It carries no credential and no provider data.

username.description: Account name, 3 to 32 characters after Unicode NFKC normalization: letters of any script, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`, starting with a letter or digit. Two names that normalize to the same lowercase form are the same name.

password.description: Local password, 8 to 128 characters after Unicode NFKC normalization, no control characters, different from the username. Hashed with Argon2id; never stored or returned as given.

LocalRegistration.description: Credentials of a new local account. Fields other than these two, such as `role`, are refused.

id.description: Provider identifier as listed by `listOAuthProviders`, such as `google` or `github`.

items.description: Providers this installation is configured for; empty when it has none or is offline.

authorizationUrl.description: Address to open in the browser to authenticate with the provider.

state.description: Value the provider returns to `redirectUri`. The client compares it with the returned one, then sends it to `completeOAuthRegistration`.

expiresAt.description: The flow can be completed until this instant.

OAuthRegistrationStarted.description: A provider registration waiting for the browser to return.

provider.description: Provider identifier as listed by `listOAuthProviders`, such as `google` or `github`.

username.description: Account name, 3 to 32 characters after Unicode NFKC normalization: letters of any script, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`, starting with a letter or digit. Two names that normalize to the same lowercase form are the same name.

redirectUri.description: Where the browser returns after the provider: an `http://127.0.0.1`, `http://localhost`, or `http://[::1]` address, or an address the installation lists in `NIHON_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URIS`. Must also be registered with the provider.

OAuthRegistrationStart.description: Starts a provider registration for a chosen username.

state.description: `state` of the flow, as returned by the provider.

code.description: Authorization code the provider returned to `redirectUri`.

OAuthRegistrationCompletion.description: The provider answer for a started registration. A flow can be completed once.

token.description: Present for a `native` client only: the opaque session token, shown once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; keep it in secure storage, never in a URL or a log.

SignedIn.description: A new session. A `web` client receives its token as an HttpOnly cookie instead.

id.description: Opaque identifier of 1 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`.

client.description: Client kind the session was opened for: `web` or `native`.

signedInWith.description: `local` for a password, otherwise the provider identifier.

expiresAt.description: The session stops authorizing anything at this instant; using it does not extend it.

Session.description: A signed-in Nihon session. It never carries the token or any provider token.

id.description: Opaque identifier of 1 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`.

role.description: Permission role of the profile, such as `user`.

SessionProfile.description: The profile the session acts for.

username.description: Account name, 3 to 32 characters after Unicode NFKC normalization: letters of any script, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`, starting with a letter or digit. Two names that normalize to the same lowercase form are the same name.

client.description: How this client keeps its session. `web`: the server sets an HttpOnly `nihon_session` cookie and the response carries no token. `native`: the response carries `token`, which the client keeps in secure storage and sends as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

LocalSignIn.description: Credentials of an existing local profile.

authorizationUrl.description: Address to open in the browser to authenticate with the provider.

state.description: Value the provider returns to `redirectUri`. The client compares it with the returned one, then sends it to `completeOAuthSignIn`.

expiresAt.description: The flow can be completed until this instant.

clientBinding.description: Present for a `native` client only: send it back to `completeOAuthSignIn`. A `web` client holds it as an HttpOnly cookie instead. Only the client that started the flow can complete it.

OAuthSignInStarted.description: A provider sign-in waiting for the browser to return.

provider.description: Provider identifier as listed by `listOAuthProviders`, such as `google` or `github`.

redirectUri.description: Where the browser returns after the provider: an `http://127.0.0.1`, `http://localhost`, or `http://[::1]` address, or an address the installation lists in `NIHON_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URIS`. Must also be registered with the provider.

client.description: How this client keeps its session. `web`: the server sets an HttpOnly `nihon_session` cookie and the response carries no token. `native`: the response carries `token`, which the client keeps in secure storage and sends as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

OAuthSignInStart.description: Starts signing in with a provider identity already linked to a profile.

state.description: `state` of the flow, as returned by the provider.

code.description: Authorization code the provider returned to `redirectUri`.

clientBinding.description: `clientBinding` of the start response; required for a `native` flow, omitted on the Web.

OAuthSignInCompletion.description: The provider answer for a started sign-in. A flow can be completed once.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Register a local account with a username and password
post.description: Works offline. Creates the profile and its credential together or not at all. No session is opened. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry after the profile was created returns the same profile instead of `accounts_username_taken`.

schema.description: Key chosen by the client for one command, such as a random UUID, sent unquoted: 16 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`. Retrying with the same key and the same input returns the confirmed response without repeating the effect; a key is never reused for another command.

parameters.description: Key chosen by the client for one command, such as a random UUID, sent unquoted: 16 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`. Retrying with the same key and the same input returns the confirmed response without repeating the effect; a key is never reused for another command.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this is the stored response of a command already committed under the same `Idempotency-Key`; the effect was not repeated.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`).

409.description: The normalized username is already used (`accounts_username_taken`). A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running; retry after `Retry-After` (`idempotency_key_in_use`).

422.description: The `Idempotency-Key` was already used by another caller, operation, or input (`idempotency_key_reused`); nothing was done.

503.description: Too many registrations are being processed; retry after `Retry-After` (`accounts_busy`). Too many recent keyed commands are recorded (`idempotency_capacity_reached`): nothing was done; space frees as records expire, and the command can be sent without a key.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

get.summary: List the providers available for registration

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Start registering with a Google or GitHub identity
post.description: Requires Internet to reach the provider. The username is checked now and again when the flow completes. The flow expires after 10 minutes.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`). `redirectUri` is not an accepted return address (`accounts_oauth_redirect_uri_invalid`).

409.description: The normalized username is already used (`accounts_username_taken`).

422.description: The provider is unknown or not configured on this installation (`accounts_oauth_provider_unavailable`).

503.description: Too many provider flows are pending; retry after `Retry-After` (`accounts_busy`).

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Complete a provider registration with the returned code
post.description: Verifies the code and identity with the provider, then creates the profile and its provider link together or not at all. The flow is consumed by the first attempt that obtains an exchange slot and the database write turn, successful or not: a replayed or concurrent completion creates nothing, while a `503` refusal for lack of capacity leaves the flow intact. An email address is neither required nor read, and profiles are never merged by email. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry after the profile was created returns the same profile instead of `accounts_oauth_state_invalid`, without calling the provider again.

schema.description: Key chosen by the client for one command, such as a random UUID, sent unquoted: 16 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`. Retrying with the same key and the same input returns the confirmed response without repeating the effect; a key is never reused for another command.

parameters.description: Key chosen by the client for one command, such as a random UUID, sent unquoted: 16 to 64 characters `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`. Retrying with the same key and the same input returns the confirmed response without repeating the effect; a key is never reused for another command.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: The profile and its provider link were created.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this is the stored response of a command already committed under the same `Idempotency-Key`; the effect was not repeated.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`). The flow is unknown or already used (`accounts_oauth_state_invalid`), expired (`accounts_oauth_state_expired`), the provider refused the code (`accounts_oauth_code_rejected`), or the identity could not be verified (`accounts_oauth_identity_unverified`).

409.description: The username was taken meanwhile (`accounts_username_taken`), or this provider identity already has a profile (`accounts_identity_already_registered`). A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running; retry after `Retry-After` (`idempotency_key_in_use`).

422.description: The flow was started for a provider this installation no longer has configured (`accounts_oauth_provider_unavailable`); the flow is consumed. The `Idempotency-Key` was already used by another caller, operation, or input (`idempotency_key_reused`); nothing was done.

502.description: The provider could not be reached or answered unusably (`accounts_oauth_provider_failed`); the flow is consumed, start a new registration.

503.description: Too many provider exchanges are running (`accounts_busy`, `Retry-After` set): the flow is untouched, retry the same completion. If instead the database stayed busy after the provider answered (`accounts_oauth_flow_consumed`, no `Retry-After`), nothing was created and the flow is used up: start a new registration. Too many recent keyed commands are recorded (`idempotency_capacity_reached`): nothing was done; space frees as records expire, and the command can be sent without a key.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Sign in with a username and password
post.description: Works offline. Opens a new session that expires 30 days later. An unknown username and a wrong password are refused alike. A session the request already presents (cookie or bearer token) is revoked in the same transaction, so switching profiles on one client leaves no session behind. When the installation already holds its maximum of sessions, the oldest one is dropped.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`).

401.description: The username and password do not match a profile with a local password (`accounts_credentials_invalid`).

503.description: Too many sign-ins are being processed; retry after `Retry-After` (`accounts_busy`).

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Start signing in with a Google or GitHub identity
post.description: Requires Internet to reach the provider. The flow expires after 10 minutes and can only be completed by the client that started it. Starting again from the same browser supersedes its previous flow, whose late return is then refused.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`). `redirectUri` is not an accepted return address (`accounts_oauth_redirect_uri_invalid`).

422.description: The provider is unknown or not configured on this installation (`accounts_oauth_provider_unavailable`).

503.description: Too many provider flows are pending; retry after `Retry-After` (`accounts_busy`).

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

post.summary: Complete a provider sign-in with the returned code
post.description: Checks that the flow belongs to this client, consumes it, verifies the code and identity with the provider, then opens a session for the profile linked to that identity. The provider's tokens are discarded: they never authorize Nihon operations. An email address is neither required nor read. A session the request already presents (cookie or bearer token) is revoked in the same transaction, so switching profiles on one client leaves no session behind. When the installation already holds its maximum of sessions, the oldest one is dropped.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`). The flow is unknown, already used, or superseded (`accounts_oauth_state_invalid`), expired (`accounts_oauth_state_expired`), started by another client (`accounts_oauth_client_mismatch`, the flow is untouched), the provider refused the code (`accounts_oauth_code_rejected`), or the identity could not be verified (`accounts_oauth_identity_unverified`).

401.description: The verified provider identity is not linked to any profile (`accounts_identity_not_registered`); register first.

422.description: The flow was started for a provider this installation no longer has configured (`accounts_oauth_provider_unavailable`); the flow is consumed.

502.description: The provider could not be reached or answered unusably (`accounts_oauth_provider_failed`); the flow is consumed, start again.

503.description: Too many provider exchanges are running (`accounts_busy`, `Retry-After` set): the flow is untouched, retry the same completion. If instead the database stayed busy after the provider answered (`accounts_oauth_flow_consumed`, no `Retry-After`), no session was opened and the flow is used up: start again.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

get.summary: Read the session this request is signed in with

401.description: No valid session: never signed in, signed out, or expired (`authentication_required`); sign in again.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

delete.summary: Sign out: revoke the session this request presents
delete.description: Send the session to sign out (the cookie on the Web, `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for a native client); without one nothing is revoked. The session is deleted at once: its token no longer authorizes any operation, on any client. The Web cookie is cleared. Always answers `204`, also when the session had already expired or been revoked, so a retry is safe. It does not disconnect any provider account.

204.description: No session remains for the presented token.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).

get.summary: Follow committed changes as server-sent events
get.description:
Opens a `text/event-stream` announcing changes after they are committed; a change never announces a transaction that was rolled back. Events invalidate: the client rereads the canonical resources of the announced topic, which stay the only source of state.

The stream starts with either a `resync` event, after which the client rereads everything it shows, or the changes missed since the position the client sent, one per topic. Positions are the events' `id`s: send the last one received in `Last-Event-ID` (browsers' `EventSource` does so when it reconnects) or in `lastEventId`; the header wins. A position from before a server restart, or older than the changes the server keeps, starts with `resync`.

A signed-in subscriber also receives the changes of its own profile, and its stream ends when its session ends; an anonymous one receives only the changes meant for everyone. A comment line is sent every 15 s. A subscriber that does not read is disconnected once 64 events wait for it, or after 30 s without progress; it reconnects with its last position.

schema.description: Opaque `id` of the last event the client received. Clients store it, never parse it.

parameters.description: Opaque `id` of the last event the client received. Clients store it, never parse it.
parameters.name: lastEventId

schema.description: Opaque `id` of the last event the client received. Clients store it, never parse it.

parameters.description: Opaque `id` of the last event the client received. Clients store it, never parse it.
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

200.description: The stream of `resync` and `change` events, until the client, its session, or the server ends it.

schema.description: Server-sent events. Each event's `data` is one line of JSON: `change` carries `ChangeNotification`, `resync` carries `ResyncNotification`.

400.description: Refused request: invalid input (`validation_failed`) or incompatible client (`unsupported_api_version`).

503.description: Too many subscriptions are open (`changes_capacity_reached`); retry after `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other error, such as `internal_error` (500), `stopping` (503), or `database_busy` (503).
